label: Arlington Composite Squadron
size_basis: estimated typical embroidered patch width 3 in (group, squadron and activity patches 3 in); the official digital artwork carries no physical size; height follows the artwork's own aspect
citation: CAPR 39-1 para 10.9 / Attachment 8 define the patch but give no dimensions
provenance: Unit emblem of Arlington Composite Squadron (MAR-DC-026), digital artwork supplied by Ethan Hillard on 2026-11-11. Official digital artwork shipped as given: webp (VP8 lossy) -> png via dwebp; the file came without transparency on a plain white ground: the white outside the emblem's own outline was made transparent (connected from the image border, white at 250 or more of 255, spreading through whitish pixels down to 215; 649802 px) and the 13588 edge pixels blended with that white were given their coverage as alpha; then reduced in size from 1632 x 1684 to 1163 x 1200 px (area average, alpha premultiplied; the long edge is held to 1200 px as the other digital patches are); no redrawing, no tracing, no colour change. It replaces the Brand Tools squadron emblem (a shield with a columned building under DC-026) that stood under this asset id. Charter: MAR-DC-026 is Arlington Composite Squadron in the builder's unit list.
notes: Official digital artwork as given, not a redraw: no thread texture added, nothing re-drawn or re-coloured. The only changes are the white ground outside the outline, made transparent so the emblem sits on the garment; the size, held to 1200 px on the long edge.
